def calculateEmployeeSalary(basic_salary):
    # Constraint handling
    if not basic_salary:
        print("Input required.")
        exit()

    # Calculations
    hra = (basic_salary * 0.20)
    da = (basic_salary * 0.10)
    gross_salary = basic_salary + hra + da
    annual_salary = gross_salary * 12 # Salary in cents / Rupees conversion

    print("HRA:", hra)
    print("DA:", da)
    print("Gross Salary:", gross_salary)
    print("Annual Salary:", annual_salary)
